'''Calliose''', a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], served as [[Skahtul]]'s principle partner during the hunt for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. 
==Biography==
Calliose was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] who was hired as the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of [[Qoronal]], a boss of the [[Klatooinian Trade Guild/Legends|Klatooinian Trade Guild]]. Calliose managed to learn his job quickly, protecting his employer's life from threats coming from rival crime syndicates; that was until Calliose's mistakes and slowness allowed rival [[agent/Legends|agents]] assassinate Qoronal.<ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> 

As a result, the Guild held Calliose responsible and put a bounty on him. Calliose fled the [[sector/Legends|sectors]] under the Guild's control and started a second career as a bounty hunter. Calliose thought that this career choice would offer a layer of protection, as he would face the hunters coming after him on equal terms, and eliminating that "competition" was a perverted part of the "bounty hunters' code".<ref name="sotesb" />

Along the way he met other ruffians with a similar background, such as former [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] of the Guild, guards who shot at the wrong target, or incompetent security experts who made some mistake and fled the Guild. He gathered them into a ragtag band and became their leader. Despite their common points, he was distrustful to them and maintained a gruff leadership, enforcing discipline by barking threats and and slapping.<ref name="sotesb" />

Calliose heard of the high prize on [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]'s head coming from different sponsors. Although he considered going after him, he found it more practical to to join the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Skahtul]]'s [[Skahtul's coalition|coalition]] in return for a share of the bounty, with his men providing extra firepower. Calliose however was suspicious that Skahtul or one of her underlings would be after him, and planned to keep an eye on anyone making a move; he also planned to let Skahtul's part to do most of the job as his own band would sit behind and watch.<ref name="sotesb" />

Bounty hunters attacked a [[Bothan safehouse]] and captured Skywalker, who was taken prisoner at [[Skahtul's hideout|a compound]] on Kothlis, while Skahtul tried to get the highest price out of them.<ref name="sote">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref><ref name="sote4">[[Shadows of the Empire 4|''Shadows of the Empire'' 4]]</ref> This backfired, as Skywalker escaped the compound with the help of his [[Force power/Legends|Jedi powers]], and was soon joined by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] who came to his rescue.<ref name="sote" /><ref name="sote4" /><ref name="sote5">[[Shadows of the Empire 5|''Shadows of the Empire'' 5]]</ref>  While the mercenaries tried to defend themselves against the two humans, Calliose's ruffians were firing against her mates.<ref name="partners">{{WEGCite|story=Partners No More|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> Around that time, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and his forces [[Battle of Kothlis|attacked Kothlis]], coming after Luke and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] invaded the hideout.<ref name="sote" /><ref name="sote5" /> Calliose then ran away.<ref name="partners" />

As Calliose was limping down an alley several blocks away, Skahtul caught up and assaulted him. She disarmed the Nikto, and pushed him against the wall. She accused him for his men letting Skywalker escape, and then, when Stormtroopers came, shooting against her men, as she threw down and kicked him, before slamming him again against the wall. Calliose denied all those accusations, blaming the fog of war. Skahtul, thinking it was the proper time to get some profit from that disastrous operation, restrained him with [[cuffbands]], she decided to deliver him to the Guild.<ref name="partners" />
